claim_boundary: Controlled label-based reward misspecification test; the hidden joint metric is not independent causal visual-grounding evidence.

criteria.name: primary_joint_contrast
criteria.requirement: minimal minus naive > 0, 95% CI lower bound > 0, and p < 0.05

criteria.name: minimal_beats_sft_joint
criteria.requirement: minimal minus SFT joint exact must be positive

criteria.name: answer_harm_vs_naive
criteria.requirement: minimal answer EM loss versus naive must be <= 0.03

criteria.name: answer_harm_vs_sft
criteria.requirement: minimal answer EM loss versus SFT must be <= 0.03

criteria.name: naive_cite_all_vs_minimal
criteria.requirement: naive cite-all rate must be at least 0.10 above minimal

criteria.name: naive_reward_hidden_divergence
criteria.requirement: naive train-reward/hidden-joint divergence must exceed minimal

criteria.name: shuffled_image_retention
criteria.requirement: shuffled EM must be <= half of unshuffled minimal EM

criteria.name: dataset_audit
criteria.requirement: dataset audit status must be pass

criteria.name: cross_split_hash_leakage
criteria.requirement: cross-split record/image/table hash overlap must be zero

criteria.name: t4_three_seed_throughput
criteria.requirement: all required SFT, naive, and minimal runs must complete 100 steps on T4

criteria.name: rollout_diagnostics_complete
criteria.requirement: naive and minimal rollout diagnostics must cover all required seeds

rollout_diagnostics.aggregation: Average completions within question, then average questions within reward arm and seed.
rollout_diagnostics.statistical_unit: Non-independent rollout diagnostics; never use rows as question-level inferential samples.
